drills.title: Clean-machine developer onboarding
drills.instructions: Run npm run onboarding:verify on a clean checkout and file the ISSUE_TEMPLATE drill form.

drills.title: Second-operator takeover
drills.instructions: Secondary operator follows docs/operations/second-operator-handover.md without the principal present.

drills.title: Staging rollback to known-good
drills.instructions: Use rollback.yml against a previous known-good release; record digest evidence only.

drills.title: Backup and restore dry-run
drills.instructions: Run ops:backup and ops:restore with --dry-run; never paste secrets into the issue.
